an10.107:1.1: [sāvatthi] atthi bhikkhave dakkhiṇesu janapadesu dhovanaṃ nāma
an10.107:1.2: tattha hoti annampi pānampi khajjampi bhojjampi leyyampi peyyampi naccampi gītampi vāditampi.
an10.107:1.3: atthetaṃ bhikkhave dhovanaṃ, netaṃ natthīti vadāmi.
an10.107:1.4: tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave dhovanaṃ hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anattha saṃhitaṃ, na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvatta ti.
an10.107:2.1: ahañca kho bhikkhave ariyaṃ dhovanaṃ desissāmī. yaṃ dhovanaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. yaṃ dhovanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti.
an10.107:2.2: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an10.107:2.3: evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ
an10.107:3.1: katamañca taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ dhovanaṃ yaṃ dhovanaṃ ekanta nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati, yaṃ dhovanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti.
an10.107:4.2: ye ca micchā diṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te cassa niddhotā honti.
an10.107:4.3: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhavanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.107:5.4: …pe… sammā ājīvassa bhikkhave micchāājīvo niddhoto hoti
an10.107:5.5: …pe… sammā vāyāmassa bhikkhave micchāvāyāmo niddhoto hoti …pe…
an10.107:6.1: sammā vimuttissa bhikkhave micchāvimutti niddhotā hoti.
an10.107:6.2: ye ca micchāvimutti paccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te cassa niddhotā honti.
an10.107:6.3: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.107:6.4: idaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ dhovanaṃ, yaṃ dhovanaṃ ekanta nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati, yaṃ dhovanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccantī
